# [TASK] Implement Gateway ActivityTrackingFilter and /actuator/activity Endpoint

## Task
Implement activity tracking in Spring Cloud Gateway to monitor user request activity, compute idle duration, and expose `/actuator/activity` for cloud watchdogs.

## Scope
- `ActivityTrackingService.java`
- `ActivityTrackingFilter.java`
- `ActivityStatusController.java`
- Unit tests in `backend/api-gateway`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Non-actuator/monitoring incoming user requests update the gateway activity timestamp.
- [x] Actuator health probes and fallback routes do not reset the inactivity timer.
- [x] `/actuator/activity` returns status, idle seconds, and auto-stop eligibility.
- [x] Unit tests pass with 100% assertions green.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3
